first_contract.name: Trouble on the Road
first_contract.description: The castle guard needs the roads cleared. Defeat three goblins.

alchemist_order.name: An Alchemist's Order
alchemist_order.description: Gather three units of Slime Gel for the castle alchemist.

red_knives_bounty.name: Bounty: Red Knives
red_knives_bounty.description: The Red Knives are terrorizing the trade road. Defeat three bandits.

lost_courier.name: The Lost Courier
lost_courier.description: Escort the rescued courier safely from the castle to the town.

dread_captain.name: The Dread Captain
dread_captain.description: The Red Knives' captain has taken refuge in the castle. End the threat.

wraith_essence.name: A Grave Matter
wraith_essence.description: Collect two Wraith Essences for a scholar studying the graveyard.

arena_iron_champion.name: Arena Trial: The Iron Champion
arena_iron_champion.description: Defeat the first special champion in the arena to prove your party is ready for legendary training.

arena_tempest_wyvern.name: Arena Trial: The Tempest Wyvern
arena_tempest_wyvern.description: Defeat the tempest-bred wyvern to earn the rangers' trust and a legendary bow.

arena_astral_regent.name: Arena Trial: The Astral Regent
arena_astral_regent.description: Defeat the undefeated final champion to unlock the Summoner discipline and its legendary grimoire.
